CheckTitle: Access Keys not rotated for users with access to services different than IAM or STS
Description: There are active access keys that have not been rotated in the last 90 days, with access to services beyond IAM or STS.
Risk: Such access keys increase the risk of unauthorized access greatly due to the related services.

Recommendation.Text: Regularly rotate access keys to limit the risk of unauthorized access, and revoke users' access to unnecessary services for their role.
